pairs.subject: drag-drop
pairs.evidence: src/features/shared/components/display/DragHandle.tsx:45 DragHandle announces a button without providing default focusability or keyboard activation, creating the false affordance explicitly prohibited by the standard.

techniques.evidence: src/features/shared/components/display/DataGrid.tsx:124 The grid delegates drag attributes to callers; these primitives implement no cross-surface receiver, negotiated payload contract, or handoff translation.

src/features/shared/components/display/ColumnResize.tsx:105 Resize listeners are removed only through pointerup; there is no Escape, pointercancel, blur, or unmount cleanup, so interrupted gestures can retain listeners and resize state.

src/features/shared/components/display/DropIndicator.tsx:53 The visual primitive provides a distinct insertion indicator that cannot intercept target hit-testing, supports either axis, and reduces its animation for reduced motion; callers own placement geometry.

src/features/shared/components/display/DragHandle.tsx:45 The rendered span has no default tabIndex or key handler despite declaring button semantics; inspected callers supply pointer behavior without repairing the grip's keyboard operability.

src/features/shared/components/display/ColumnResize.tsx:76 Interface-owned widths update immediately, but persistence failure only logs a warning instead of retrying and surfacing failure, allowing an apparently accepted layout to disappear after reload.

src/features/shared/components/display/ColumnResize.tsx:81 The implemented gesture changes a column dimension using its key; entity payload transport and positional reorder statements are not implemented by this context.
